units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (wall noise p99 <= 2 grey levels between frame 0 and 29; mat edges unchanged)
camera.view: front view of a wall with a desk mat in the foreground, slightly elevated camera looking at the mat's top surface; the typewriter falls vertically in a plane roughly facing the camera

typewriter.description: black vintage typewriter with cream keys; the only moving object. Falls from the top-centre, lands on the desk mat, rocks/tips and comes to rest
typewriter.reference_point: cx_bbox, cy_bbox (centre of the 2D mask bounding box) = best proxy for the object origin; cx_mask/cy_mask (mask centroid) also given

pixel_size_airborne_frames_0_2.height_y_px: 125 (frame 0; frames 7-9 bbox heights 146-169 px are inflated by vertical motion blur)
pixel_size_airborne_frames_0_2.note: horizontal extent 292-293 px is stable during the whole fall (frames 0-10) and is the most reliable size measure

pixel_size_at_rest_frames_23_29.note: at rest it shows its front/top (keys, platen) under perspective, so width includes some depth foreshortening; right edge ~1192 measured by eye because the paper prop touches it (mask is clipped at x=1195)

desk_mat.description: large rectangular desk mat / blotter with a reddish-brown border, lying on the floor/table at the bottom of the frame; the typewriter lands on it
desk_mat.front_edge: below the bottom of the frame (not visible)
desk_mat.note: corners +-5 px (left corner estimated visually; vignetting makes the left wall dark)

paper_card.description: small cream paper card on the mat to the right of the typewriter's landing spot, under the scissors

scissors.description: dark metal scissors lying on the paper card

small_dark_block.description: small dark brown block/stamp at the right end of the scissors

events.note: already moving at frame 0 (frame0->1 drop 8 px); no hold frames
front-bottom edge at y~975-982, ~45 px above its resting contact line
first frame in contact (bottom y=1028); impact lies between frames 10 and 11
bbox top rises from y=853 (f11) to 793 (f15) then falls back to 853 (f19-21) while bottom stays at the mat (y~1011-1028): rocking rotation, not a free bounce
